register.labelZh: SLIP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: slip away 可以表示某人悄悄離開會議、派對或房間,而沒有引起別人注意。；slip something on、slip something off 和 slip out of something 可以自然地描述迅速而輕鬆地穿上或脫下衣物。；slip over 可以清楚直接地描述某人因地面、道路或小徑濕滑、結冰或有泥濘而滑倒。；slip away 表示離開;slip on 和 slip off 與衣物有關;slip over 則表示滑倒。
register.summaryEn: Slip away is useful when somebody leaves a meeting, party or room quietly and without attracting attention. Slip something on, slip something off and slip out of something are natural ways to describe putting on or removing clothes quickly and easily. Slip over gives a clear and direct way to describe somebody falling because a floor, road or path is wet, icy or muddy. Slip away describes leaving, slip on and slip off describe clothes, and slip over describes falling.
